title: Modules
dailyToolsHelp: Pin the tools that matter most to your team. They will appear here and stay visible in the modules tab.
emailText: Send campaigns and transactional messages. Credits are used per recipient.
audienceText: Manage subscribers. Adding, subscribing and unsubscribing are free.
bookingText: Accept appointment requests and use credits only after completed bookings.
rentText: Publish rentable items and spend credits only when requests are approved.
storeText: Show Stripe products on the public site and let customers buy from one cart.
calendarText: See active bookings, rental requests and internal reminders in one calendar.
kanbanText: Organize work with draggable cards, assignees, dates and important notes.
logsText: Track service events from the connected Supabase project.
pagesText: Publish the public profile, about card and customer-facing pages.
privatePagesText: Create internal HTML pages for procedures, notes and team-only content.
